text: A frog lived at the bottom of a well.
Above him, one small circle of sky.
"That is the whole sky," he said. "I have seen all of it."
One day, a sea turtle looked down.
"Come up," said the turtle. "The sky is far bigger."
The frog laughed. "Bigger than my sky? Impossible."
So the turtle told him of the sea.
Wider than a thousand wells. Deeper than mountains are tall.
The frog said nothing. Then, for the first time, he climbed.
And the sky had no edge at all.
Your sky is only as big as your well.
